name: Sugar maple sap, as tapped
source: Proximate (per kg) water 980 g, sugar (sucrose) 19 g (~2%, typical sugar maple sap concentration), ash 1 g — real sap sugar content commonly ranges 1-3%.
notes: Standard sucrose elemental ratio (sap sugar is predominantly sucrose, unlike honey's inverted sugar). Boiling down to maple-syrup.json (origin/maple.ts) removes water via the same real technique agri/harvest.ts's dryGrain uses, matching the widely cited ~40:1 sap-to-syrup ratio.
